plugins.description: Claude skills for the person who runs the week: weekly meeting prep, one-on-ones, meeting notes to actions, same-page meetings with the Visionary, clarity breaks, rock check-ins, solving issues to the root cause, writing rocks, quarterly and annual planning prep, process maps and SOPs, and messages for every audience.
